biggest_catch: Pays by PAPER CHECK only — no PayPal or direct deposit — so cash arrives weeks after you request it; also it passively tracks your web browsing (data-for-money tradeoff).
catches: Paid by paper check only (minimum $1 to request, but checks take weeks to arrive); no instant digital payout.
SavvyConnect is passive research software: it monitors your web browsing habits — users must accept that data collection.
Official rate is now $3 per device per month (older reviews cite $5/device; the current official homepage says $3).
Rewards accumulate slowly — one device earns $36/year; meaningful money needs multiple devices plus surveys.
SavvyConnect is tied to a SurveySavvy account; you must also do occasional surveys for expedited payments.

steps: Sign up for a free SurveySavvy account at surveysavvy.com.
Download and install SavvyConnect on your smartphone, tablet and/or PC (setup takes under 2 minutes).
Browse the web as usual — the app passively records browsing for market research.
Earn monthly cash rewards per device plus access to higher-paying surveys.
Request payment (paper check) once your balance hits the $1 minimum.
timing: Monthly cash rewards; payments are by paper check (slow — weeks to arrive), minimum $1 to request.
